title: Overnight French Toast Breakfast Bake
description: A delicious overnight French toast bake that's perfect for a weekend breakfast or brunch.
steps: Start with a loaf of bread and a sharp knife. Remove all the crust from the loaf and set aside. Save the crust for later.
In a mixing bowl, add six eggs, one cup of milk, half a cup of heavy whipping cream, and one teaspoon of vanilla extract. Whisk everything together.
Melt a stick of butter. Add one cup of brown sugar to the melted butter and stir well.
Pour the brown sugar and butter mixture into an 11x13-inch baking dish, spreading it evenly.
Lay the bread in a layer across the dish. For a neat layer, cut the bread into pieces if desired.
Pour half of the egg mixture over the bread layer. Sprinkle cinnamon on top.
Add another layer of bread, then pour the remaining egg mixture over it. Press down on dry spots to ensure everything is coated.
Cover the dish with saran wrap and refrigerate overnight.

In the morning, remove the saran wrap and cover with an inverted second sheet pan or a stainless pan over the dish. Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 45 minutes, removing the cover for the last 15 minutes (30 min covered, then 15 uncovered).
Remove from oven, let cool slightly, and serve. Optional toppings include powdered sugar, maple syrup, strawberries, or whipped cream.
